conventions: Committed work = standalone awards + task orders at current_total_value_of_award, floored at 0 per award. Vehicle seats = IDIQ/BPA-type vehicle positions, counted separately at potential_ceiling floored at 0 per award (negative reported values are reporting artifacts). Vehicle numbers never blend into award-size statistics. Runway/headroom floored at 0 per award.
precondition: ≥1 active award of any kind (current_end_date ≥ today AND NOT is_terminated) within the selected scope
disjointness: Every (award-NAICS6, award-PSC4) pair belongs to exactly one bucket; bucket unions in the explorer never double-count.
